new_scoped_claims: Residue-field countability is necessary and sufficient for sequential approximation of the specified native Gauss boundary jump over every complete nontrivially valued field.
A globally specified negative analytic logarithmic series has an explicit decreasing semipositive strict real-PL sequence, including extended poles.
Native and pulled-back boundary jumps can differ after scalar extension; an explicit Gauss-valued extension illustrates this.
original_gaps: No geometric characterization for all arbitrary classical psh germs in higher dimension.
The sequence obstruction has explicit decreasing nets and therefore gives no obstruction to a net formulation.
No general representation of arbitrary classical psh functions by the analytic logarithmic input data.
No general scalar descent, normalization descent, or compatible tropical-chart construction for arbitrary starting functions.
evidence_limit: Finite rational checks, manifest hashes and successful TeX builds do not certify mathematical correctness. Published foundations are imported with exact scope; deeper recursive proofs are not freshly established.
